semantics: Daily slots: every configured local time on every allowed ISO weekday (1 = Monday) of the schedule's timezone, as UTC instants, ascending; equal instants are de-duplicated.

Nonexistent local times (spring-forward gap) use the UTC offset in effect before the gap (PEP 495 fold=0), i.e. they land after the gap, shifted forward by its length: London 01:30 on 2026-03-29 -> 01:30Z (02:30 BST).
Ambiguous local times (fall-back fold) use their first occurrence (the pre-transition offset).
Slot s (the latest slot <= now and >= schedule_since) is satisfied by last_entry_at >= s - min(early_window_max, (s - p) / 2), p being the slot before s (no p: early_window_max).
Daily: not satisfied -> is_due, due_since = s. No slot in [schedule_since, now] -> not due.
next_due_at (daily) is the first slot > now not already satisfied by last_entry_at (slots before schedule_since still count as p for the half-gap window).
Interval: due_at = max(last_entry_at, schedule_since) + every_minutes (schedule_since when never logged); is_due = now >= due_at; due_since = due_at when due; next_due_at = due_at.
Archived: never due; due_since and next_due_at are null.
Slots are searched in [now - lookback_days, now + lookahead_days].

due_message: now - due_since < 30 min -> 'Time to log'; else in the schedule's timezone: same local date -> 'Overdue since HH:MM'; fewer than 7 local calendar days -> 'Overdue since Ddd HH:MM'; else 'Overdue since DD Mmm'. Ddd/Mmm are C-locale English abbreviations, DD zero-padded, 24-hour clock.
